# wallix.bastion.domain_account_credential

Manage credentials of global domain accounts on a WALLIX Bastion — module

*Added in version 1.0.0 of `wallix.bastion`.*

## Synopsis

- Create, update or delete the password or the SSH key of an account of a global domain on a WALLIX Bastion.
- Equivalent of the `wallix-bastion_domain_account_credential` Terraform resource.
- An account has at most one credential of each [`type`](#parameter-type), so [`type`](#parameter-type) identifies the credential.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Comments |
|---|---|---|
| <a id="parameter-account-name"></a>**account_name** | `str` / required | Name of the account (see [`wallix.bastion.domain_account`](domain_account.md)).<br>The domain and the account must exist, unless [`state=absent`](#parameter-state). |
| <a id="parameter-api-version"></a>**api_version** | `str` | Version of the Bastion REST API to use, `v3.8` or `v3.12`.<br>If not set, the value of the `WALLIX_BASTION_API_VERSION` environment variable is used, then `v3.12`. |
| <a id="parameter-bastion-host"></a>**bastion_host** | `str` | Hostname or IP address of the WALLIX Bastion.<br>If not set, the value of the `WALLIX_BASTION_HOST` environment variable is used. |
| <a id="parameter-bastion-password"></a>**bastion_password** | `str` | Password of [`bastion_user`](#parameter-bastion-user).<br>If not set, the value of the `WALLIX_BASTION_PASSWORD` environment variable is used.<br>One of [`bastion_password`](#parameter-bastion-password) or [`bastion_token`](#parameter-bastion-token) is required. |
| <a id="parameter-bastion-port"></a>**bastion_port** | `int` | HTTPS port of the WALLIX Bastion API.<br>If not set, the value of the `WALLIX_BASTION_PORT` environment variable is used, then `443`. |
| <a id="parameter-bastion-timeout"></a>**bastion_timeout** | `int` | Timeout in seconds of each HTTP request to the Bastion API.<br><br>Default: `30` |
| <a id="parameter-bastion-token"></a>**bastion_token** | `str` | API key of [`bastion_user`](#parameter-bastion-user). Takes precedence over [`bastion_password`](#parameter-bastion-password).<br>If not set, the value of the `WALLIX_BASTION_TOKEN` environment variable is used. |
| <a id="parameter-bastion-user"></a>**bastion_user** | `str` | User to authenticate with. With [`bastion_token`](#parameter-bastion-token), the user the API key belongs to.<br>If not set, the value of the `WALLIX_BASTION_USER` environment variable is used. |
| <a id="parameter-csrf-enabled"></a>**csrf_enabled** | `bool` | Send the CSRF token the Bastion issues at login (Bastion 12.0.3 and later).<br>If not set, the value of the `WALLIX_CSRF_ENABLED` environment variable is used, then `true`. |
| <a id="parameter-domain-name"></a>**domain_name** | `str` / required | Name of the global domain of the account (see [`wallix.bastion.domain`](domain.md)). |
| <a id="parameter-passphrase"></a>**passphrase** | `str` | Passphrase protecting [`private_key`](#parameter-private-key), for [`type=ssh_key`](#parameter-type).<br>The Bastion never returns it, so it cannot be compared. It can only be changed together with [`private_key`](#parameter-private-key). |
| <a id="parameter-password"></a>**password** | `str` | The password, for [`type=password`](#parameter-type).<br>Required when the credential does not exist yet. The Bastion never returns it, so it cannot be compared. See [`update_password`](#parameter-update-password). |
| <a id="parameter-private-key"></a>**private_key** | `str` | The private key, for [`type=ssh_key`](#parameter-type), or `generate:<TYPE>` to let the Bastion generate one, for example `generate:RSA_4096` or `generate:ED25519`.<br>Required when the credential does not exist yet.<br>The Bastion never returns it, so it cannot be compared. See [`update_password`](#parameter-update-password). |
| <a id="parameter-propagate-credential-change"></a>**propagate_credential_change** | `bool` | When the password is sent, also have the Bastion change it on the target accounts.<br>Needs password change enabled on the domain (see `enable_password_change`).<br>On update, the password is then only changed through the password change of the domain.<br><br>Default: `false` |
| <a id="parameter-state"></a>**state** | `str` | Whether the credential should exist.<br><br>Choices: `present` (default), `absent` |
| <a id="parameter-type"></a>**type** | `str` / required | Type of the credential. Identifies the credential of the account.<br><br>Choices: `password`, `ssh_key` |
| <a id="parameter-update-password"></a>**update_password** | `str` | `on_create` sends the secret options only when the credential is created.<br>`always` sends them on every run, which then always reports a change. With [`type=ssh_key`](#parameter-type), the key of the existing credential is replaced in place; with `generate:<TYPE>`, a new key is generated on every run.<br><br>Choices: `always`, `on_create` (default) |
| <a id="parameter-validate-certs"></a>**validate_certs** | `bool` | Whether to validate the Bastion's TLS certificate.<br>Only disable this for test instances with self-signed certificates.<br>If not set, `WALLIX_BASTION_VALIDATE_CERTS` is used, then the inverse of `WALLIX_INSECURE_SKIP_VERIFY`, then `true`. |

## Attributes

| Attribute | Support | Description |
|---|---|---|
| **check_mode** | full | Can run in check_mode and return changed status prediction without modifying target. |
| **diff_mode** | full<br>Secret options never appear in the diff. | Will return details on what has changed (or possibly needs changing in check_mode), when in diff mode. |

## Notes

- The environment variables are the ones of the `wallix/wallix-bastion` Terraform provider, so one shell configuration serves both tools.
- Set the connection options once per play with `module_defaults` and the `group/wallix.bastion.bastion` action group.
- These modules call the Bastion API from the host they run on; use them with `delegate_to` or on a play targeting `localhost`.

## Examples

```yaml
- name: Set the password of a domain account
  wallix.bastion.domain_account_credential:
    domain_name: corp
    account_name: administrator
    type: password
    password: "{{ vault_admin_password }}"

- name: Rotate it on every run
  wallix.bastion.domain_account_credential:
    domain_name: corp
    account_name: administrator
    type: password
    password: "{{ vault_admin_password }}"
    update_password: always

- name: Let the Bastion generate an SSH key for the account
  wallix.bastion.domain_account_credential:
    domain_name: corp
    account_name: administrator
    type: ssh_key
    private_key: generate:ED25519
  register: key

- name: Show its public key
  ansible.builtin.debug:
    msg: "{{ key.domain_account_credential.public_key }}"

- name: Remove the SSH key
  wallix.bastion.domain_account_credential:
    domain_name: corp
    account_name: administrator
    type: ssh_key
    state: absent
```

## Return values

| Key | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| <a id="return-changed-fields"></a>**changed_fields** | `list / elements=str` | Secret options sent to the Bastion, with [`update_password=always`](#parameter-update-password).<br><br>Returned: when the credential already existed and [`state=present`](#parameter-state)<br><br>Sample: `["password"]` |
| <a id="return-domain-account-credential"></a>**domain_account_credential** | `dict` | The credential as returned by the Bastion API after the change, without the secret options.<br>In check mode, the expected credential. `null` when [`state=absent`](#parameter-state).<br><br>Returned: always<br><br>Sample: see [below](#sample-domain-account-credential) |

